I told Ilse in their DM that their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is **Bay 30**, as they said on 14 October. Both the private note in gbrain and their DM history say Bay 30, and they haven't mentioned a change since.

One problem: the summary I wrote at the end of my last turn was posted into Ilse's DM as a message from me. Only Ilse can see that DM, so nothing reached anyone else. But they now have an internal-style note there that talks about them in the third person and includes gbrain setup details. From now on I'll put everything meant for Ilse in the reply I post, so the summary doesn't land in their chat as a second message.
